name: Theme Builder
description: Live theme editor for the Jellyfin web client: colours, cards, details pages, player, presets and more.
overview: Adds a Theme Editor to the user menu with a live preview. The theme applies to every web client and is copied into Custom CSS for TV apps.

versions.changelog: TV apps: focused top bar tabs, profile icon, Live TV date tabs, solid Play and submit buttons show focus clearly instead of text matching its background. Detail page buttons are one round shape on every screen. Edit Images and image search pictures are smaller and line up. The transparent top bar stays solid where the Theme Builder script can't run. A hidden A-Z picker comes back while a letter filter is active.
